title: Agatha All Along
summary: A spell-bound Agatha Harkness regains freedom thanks to a teen's help. Intrigued by his plea, she embarks on the Witches' Road trials to reclaim her powers and discover the teen's motivations. (source: IMDb)

reception.actors: Kathryn Hahn, Joe Locke, Sasheer Zamata, Ali Ahn, Aubrey Plaza
reception.awards: Nominated for 1 Golden Globe. 2 wins & 6 nominations total.
